title: SIDEREAL|SPEED3 with ECL_T0/SSY_PLANE returns zero longitude speed
implementation_plan: Options: (a) in calc_speed3, when SIDEREAL with ECL_T0/SSY bits is set, pass SPEED into inner_flags so x2000 carries real velocity (then projection speed is analytic, consistent with C SPEED3 producing projected-position derivatives is still a mismatch but non-zero/correct order); or (b) reject SIDEREAL|SPEED3 + projection bits with UnsupportedFlags; or (c) project positions only and keep the 3-point speed for the ecliptic longitude. Add a golden test: SIDEREAL|SPEED3 with mode 18 (J2000) for Sun/Moon, compared against C swetest, plus a Rust cross-check that SPEED3 lon_speed ≈ SPEED lon_speed. Verify default-branch SPEED3 still matches.
reproduction: eph.set_sidereal_mode(18,0,0) (J2000 → ECL_T0); eph.calc(2451545.0, Sun, MOSEPH|SIDEREAL|SPEED3).data[3] == 0.0, whereas MOSEPH|SIDEREAL|SPEED gives 1.019391809. Default-branch modes (e.g. Lahiri) are unaffected.
root_cause: In Ephemeris::calc_speed3 (src/context.rs), the 3-point finite-difference speed is computed into x1, then apply_sidereal is called with flags_used|SPEED. For the ECL_T0/SSY_PLANE branches, apply_sidereal does NOT correct x1's speed (as the default branch does via apply_sidereal_default subtracting daya[1]); instead trop_ra2sid_lon/_sosy recompute x1[6..12]/[18..24] from x2000 and OVERWRITE the polar speed. But calc_speed3 runs inner evals with inner_flags = flags & !SPEED3 (no SPEED), and Moshier calc_planet only populates velocity when SPEED is set (src/calc.rs ~line 353 zeros it otherwise). So x2000's velocity is zero on the SPEED3 path, and the projected longitude speed collapses to ~0. The default branch escapes this because it only adjusts the already-correct 3-point speed rather than recomputing from x2000.
